newsitem.title: CHINA: More than 20 pct of China beer below--standard.
newsitem.headline: More than 20 pct of China beer below--standard.

text.p: About 21 percent of Chinese beer brands failed to meet quality standards in a recent survey, but this is a dramatic improvement over three years ago when 55 percent failed the grade, the Business News said on Wednesday.
The Shanghai-based newspaper said the survey in July and August covered 118 types of beer from 15 parts of China, and indicated that quality was improving even as output expanded.
It said 78.8 percent of the beers tested met quality standards, compared to only 45.8 percent in the 1993 survey.
